Home.aboutBody: Athulkrishna is a Paris-based photographer and filmmaker working under the name AX7MOV. With more than two years of experience, he creates cinematic imagery for people, independent brands, automobiles, and small events. His work combines thoughtful composition, natural movement, and atmospheric light to turn everyday moments into memorable visual stories.

About.title: Instinct, atmosphere, and a quiet kind of precision.
About.bio: Athulkrishna is a Paris-based freelance photographer and filmmaker working under the name AX7MOV. With more than two years of experience, he creates cinematic imagery for people, independent brands, automobiles, and small events. His work combines thoughtful composition, natural movement, and atmospheric light to turn everyday moments into memorable visual stories.
About.note: The current portfolio imagery centres on automotive work. Portrait, event, and behind-the-scenes selections will be added as those assets become available.
About.approachTitle: Compose with intention. Leave room for life.
About.approachBody: Every project starts with the emotion it needs to carry. From there, the frame is built around real movement, tactile detail, and light that feels lived-in rather than imposed.
About.processTitle: Clear enough to trust. Flexible enough to feel natural.
About.estimate: Project estimates depend on scope, production needs, and travel distance.

Process.discoverBody: Understand the story, audience, location, and desired mood.
Process.planBody: Develop the visual direction, schedule, and practical production details.
Process.createBody: Photograph or film with an emphasis on natural movement and cinematic light.
Process.deliverBody: Edit, refine, and provide optimized final assets.
